content_sections.heading: Kudumbashree District Mission Coordinator Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of application scrutiny, a mandatory presentation, and an interview process. Scrutiny of applications received at Kudumbashree State Mission by the Committee. Shortlisted candidates shall prepare a presentation on Kudumbashree based on a format shared with them. Interview or interaction conducted by an Interview Panel. Only applications of officers selected through the interview process will be forwarded to the Government for appointment.

Enclose certificates from the parent department certifying that no disciplinary action or vigilance cases are pending against you, along with a work and conduct certificate. Send the completed application to The Executive Director, State Poverty Eradication Mission (Kudumbashree), TRIDA Building, Chalakuzhy Lane, MedicalCollege, Thiruvananthapuram-695011, or via email to [email protected] on or before 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is Kudumbashree District Mission Coordinator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a deputation appointment process initiated by the State Poverty Eradication Mission (Kudumbashree) to fill District Mission Coordinator and Assistant District Mission Coordinator vacancies from eligible State Government employees.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 66 anticipated vacancies are available, comprising 14 District Mission Coordinator posts and 52 Assistant District Mission Coordinator posts across various missions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 31-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for District Mission Coordinator?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Post Graduate degree in Social Work, Rural Development, Public Administration, Management, Economics, Social Sciences, or Literature, along with 5 years of regular government service.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary scale for Assistant District Mission Co-ordinator?
faq.answer: The scale of pay for Assistant District Mission Co-ordinator is 37400-79000.
